name: an-unpaired-surrogate-escape-in-an-object-key-is-rejected
why: The same rule applies to object keys. It is its own fixture because a key is read before its value is, and because the refusal must not quote the key: a message carrying an unpaired surrogate cannot itself be written as UTF-8, which is how the reference implementation's duplicate-key refusal would have failed on {"\ud800":1,"\ud800":2}.
